# Generated by spec-lang build from app apps.cpp.TodoCpp (apps/cpp.slg). Do not edit: change the spec.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(todo_cpp LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# A spec may compare a value with itself on purpose: that is not a mistake of the generated code.
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -Wno-tautological-compare)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL GNU)
  # GCC reports the standard containers' own moves as maybe-uninitialized when it inlines them.
  add_compile_options(-Wno-maybe-uninitialized)
endif()

# The app's notes, for its libraries' build files.
set(APP_NAME "TodoCpp")
set(APP_NOTE_cli_bin_name "todo")
set(APP_NOTE_cli_store_at "file")
set(APP_NOTE_cli_store_at_path ".todo.json")

# The program: its modules, the machine, the manifest, the runtime prelude. No library, no I/O.
add_library(program STATIC
  src/program/data.cpp
  src/program/machine.cpp
  src/program/manifest.cpp
  src/rt/data.cpp
  src/rt/text.cpp
  src/rt/value.cpp
  src/todo/board.cpp
  src/todo/laws.cpp
  src/todo/model.cpp
  src/todo/render.cpp
)
target_include_directories(program PUBLIC include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# The program with its foreign declarations: bound to the libraries' runtimes for the app, and blocked
# for tests, where a check that reaches a foreign body is blocked, never run.
add_library(program_real INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(program_real INTERFACE program)
add_library(program_blocked INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(program_blocked INTERFACE program)

# The app: `main` hands the manifest to the library that runs it.
add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE program_real)

# The program's own checks, as `spec-lang test` runs them.
enable_testing()
add_executable(checks
  tests/checks.cpp
  tests/rt/random.cpp
  tests/rt/suite.cpp
)
target_include_directories(checks PRIVATE tests)
target_link_libraries(checks PRIVATE program_blocked)
add_test(NAME checks COMMAND checks)

# The libraries' runtimes, each as its own build file says.
include(lib/cli/runtime.cmake)
